connection.timeout:
The earbuds did not respond (connection timed out). Make sure they are nearby and powered on.
If the problem persists, turn Bluetooth off on your computer, wait 10 seconds, then turn it back on and retry the connection in MiBudsClient.
If the problem persists, place both earbuds in the charging case, close the lid completely, wait 5 seconds, then take them out and try connecting again.
